pull_request.title: Calorimeter: measure 10k electron response with a smaller LAr gap
pull_request.head: codex/lar-gap-10k-response
pull_request.body:
Tests the proposed LAr barrel/endcap warm-gap reduction from800 to400mm with the exact standard10000 electron primaries. Entire endcaps move400mm towards the IP; barrel, all internal shapes/materials/local services, readout IDs and the existing segmentation guard are preserved. This is an isolated ECAL-only B=0 response study, stacked on #143, governing DES-032/DES-033 and TASK-LAR-GAP10K.

Complete accepted sensitive-deposit A/E results:

| Measure |800mm warm gap|400mm warm gap|
|---|---:|---:|
|Global sample SD/mean|17.84%|13.56%|
|Fixed999-primary transition SD/mean|44.18%|21.00%|
|Common low-response tails /10000|183|0|

Paired95% interval for the transition width change is−25.93 to−20.60 percentage points; globally−4.80 to−3.78 points.1000 shared whole-primary bootstrap replicates, seed13001000; frozen common threshold R<0.07966135709622409. Zero sample tails do not exclude nonzero population rate.

Independent observation accounts for every accepted positive sensitive-step deposit A, successful native-cell energy S and unassigned U; saved float32 hit H stays separate. Both full observed10k runs reproduce every retained saved event/cell/energy/position exactly. Rare cell-assignment omissions are measured without changing the readout or inventing cells. A separately versioned catalog-bound reader corrects logical/physical volume-name matching while retaining all original producers and raw artifacts.

Validation includes290216 native placements/166 exact solid definitions, unchanged material-region bijection and zero overlaps/extrusions at10nm for both geometries; exact serial/MT24 controls and100-event pilots; full primary/map/worker/source/library/hash checks and per-cell precision/A=S+U closure;47 focused pure tests; separate software/interface assessments and final independent PhysVal review at777452601a742aa267f63c2cfd37d71aba830893 with no actionable findings. Independent direct-index resampling reproduces intervals and all84covariance elements. Compact statistics,84-variable covariance, plots, exact reproduction and selected work/token records are included. Full ROOT/XML/events/step/native ledgers remain ignored locally.

The gap is a conditional numerical sensitivity, not an engineered400mm routing fit. The unresolved external pipes/ports/collars/board/install/forward interfaces from #143 are not integrated. These spectrum/angular SD/mean widths are not fixed-energy intrinsic resolution, digitized performance or a new LAr-vs-SiW technology decision. No production default or design sign-off changes. Remains draft for maintainer review.

Work identification: M1 / StageB / WS-CALO / TASK-LAR-GAP10K; own canonical session and exact completed child-turn usage, active coordinator excluded rather than estimated. Eighteen closed current-task child turns are recorded uniquely (64,106,016 input +230,280 output); active coordinator coverage remains unknown.
